clusters.description: List of named host groups. Each entry becomes one line in the clusters file. A host token may be a bare hostname, an FQDN, or the name of another cluster defined in this file (inheritance/nesting).

name.description: Cluster identifier used on the clusterssh command line and in cluster-reference tokens of other clusters. No spaces.

description.description: One-line comment shown above the cluster entry. Describe purpose or environment (e.g. 'Production web tier, EU region').

hosts.description: Ordered list of FQDNs, short hostnames, or other cluster names that belong to this group.
